<!-- Adding a prompt? Your entry in prompts.json should look like this. No need to run anything: CI checks it and rebuilds the feeds after merge. -->

```json
{
  "id": "short-kebab-case-id",
  "title": "What the prompt does",
  "category": "Codebase audits and simplification",
  "tags": ["audit"],
  "use_when": "One sentence on when it helps.",
  "scope": "project",
  "added_on": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "prompt": "The prompt text, exactly as posted.",
  "source": {
    "url": "https://x.com/someone/status/123",
    "author": "@someone",
    "status": "unverified"
  }
}
```
